reviews.title: It doesn’t work!!
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with Todoist’s notifications. Even for urgent tasks and reminders, the notification appears briefly and disappears like a regular notification, making it very easy to miss.

I expected stronger, more persistent alerts—especially for important tasks. For a paid productivity app, the reminder system should be much more noticeable and reliable.

reviews.title: Completely loses items

I can only guess required syncing to Todoist servers rather than much superior local storage is completely broken and a SEVERE risk for anyone using this app.  Avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: Almost awesome
reviews.text:
The review is based on the value for multiple users of a paid subscription.  

The fact that this isn’t eligible for family sharing is a dealbreaker for the paid subscription- we fortunately realized before the free period ran out.  We wanted to pay for the app, but the cost is too high when the free version is good enough.  If we could do family share on a pro subscription, it would be perfect.

reviews.title: Nice app with extortion pricing

reviews.title: User
reviews.text: I was enjoying it but with software updates it tells me to download the latest version but will not allow it (I guess the new version can’t be run on older platforms). So, it still asks me to download the new version each time I open it, and it now no longer syncs between devices. And, as far as I can tell, there is NO WAY to contact customer support or get any help with it. A useful tool which has become a time suck..

reviews.title: La mise à jour fait tout perdre

Pas sûre de continuer à m'en servir, dans ces conditions

reviews.title: No longer supporting older iOS and shutting down!
reviews.text: I’ve been paid a user of this app for years. It’s helped me manage my cognitive needs as a part of my disability. Some of the updates to this app have made it less accessible and when I’ve reached out, I’ve never gotten a response. Now, the developers/management have decided to no longer support devices below iOS 17 and they are shutting my version down. My devices STILL work and I cannot afford to buy new things. These business decisions are made because the bottom line matters more than access and people with special needs do not matter. That is a horrible thing to experience. I can’t express my disappointment to loose access (and the energy I’ll need to use to learn something new) when this app stops working across my devices if I don’t spend money to get new stuff. AND the browser isn’t supported on a mobile device when they shut down the app! Their response to my “no longer supported device is that I can use it on my other devices. For the well-healed crowd apparently! And they just charged me for another year and none of my devices work!
